sections.title: Product details
sections.text: Carnilove True Fresh Dry Turkey Pack (12kg + 6x 400g) – fresh dry turkey food + 6 tins of turkey, reindeer and wild boar pâté included! Out of respect for the instincts and natural food needs of dogs, the Carnilove brand has created a promotional package exclusively for adult dogs of all breeds. For just the price of 12kg of dry food, you get 6 large boxes (400g each) of delicious wild meat pâte. This is the ultimate opportunity to give your dog a varied, protein-rich diet and hydration to grow. The whole package is 100% grain-free, potato-free and meat-free! 12 kg Dry food: 60% fresh turkey - digestible proteins and vitality The core of the package - True Fresh dry food - contains 60% fresh turkey meat. Fresh turkey is a highly digestible source of lean protein, naturally rich in zinc, selenium and B-complex vitamins. The exclusive use of fresh meat provides an intense natural taste and aroma, supporting strong muscles and overall fitness without stressing the digestive system. 6x 400g tins of turkey, reindeer and wild boar pâte – a bonus for the wild feast The included pack of 6 tins of wet food in a smooth pâté contains a noble mixture of meat of wild origin: turkey, reindeer and wild boar. This not only provides a sensory feast for your dog, but also a rich variety of essential amino acids and minerals. The high moisture content of wet foods promotes essential hydration and supports urinary tract health. Superfoods and salmon oil – digestion, immunity and shiny coat The dry food formula is enriched with red lentils and dried apples (food fiber for digestion) as well as spirulina, ginger and sea buckthorn, forming a powerful antioxidant shield. Added salmon oil provides Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA), ensuring healthy skin and a vibrant, shiny coat. How to serve Carnilove True Fresh Dry Turkey pack? This package format is perfect for mixed feeding. Use dry kibble as a healthy daily foundation that supports dental health, and serve canned turkey, reindeer and wild boar as a hydrating meal or appetizing topper over dry food. Always ensure constant access to fresh drinking water.

sections.title: Product details
sections.text: Carnilove True Fresh Dry Turkey pack for sterilized cats (6kg + 6x 85g) – fresh dry turkey food + 6 sachets of duck and catnip in jelly included! Out of respect for the instincts and specific metabolic requirements of spayed and neutered cats, the Carnilove brand has created a promotional package exclusively for adult cats of all breeds. For just the price of 6kg dry food, you get 6 large sachets (85g each) of delicious catnip duck meat served in savory jelly. This is the ultimate opportunity to support your spayed cat's weight management and hydration while providing an exciting daily menu. The entire set is 100% grain-free, potato-free and meat-free! 6 kg dry food: 70% fresh turkey - digestible protein, weight control and taurine Core of the package - True Fresh dry food - contains 70% fresh turkey meat. Fresh turkey serves as a source of lean, highly digestible protein, rich in zinc, selenium and B-complex vitamins. Controlled fat levels effectively help prevent weight gain in neutered cats, while natural taurine supports vital heart and vision functions. 6 sachets of 85 g. DUCK JELLIES for cats with duck and itine - hydration and sensory excitement in jelly. The pack includes 6 sachets of wet food containing tender pieces of duck in a delicious and savory jelly. The addition of natural catnip stimulates your cat's senses and encourages mealtime excitement even for picky feline eaters. The high moisture content promotes essential body hydration, supporting urinary tract health. Cranberries, sea buckthorn and hair follicle control – urinary health and digestion. Spayed cats require dedicated urinary support. Cranberries and sea buckthorn help maintain optimal urinary pH levels to protect the kidneys and urinary tract. Balanced dietary fiber facilitates the smooth and safe passage of ingested hair through the digestive tract (hair bubble control formula). Salmon oil – for healthy skin and soft fur The recipe includes premium salmon oil, a rich source of Omega-3 and Omega-6 essential fatty acids. These nutrients soothe delicate skin, reduce inflammation and give your cat's coat a thick, velvety sheen. How to serve Carnilove True Fresh Dry Pack for sterilized cats? This package format is ideal for mixed feeding. Use dry kibble as a daily nutritional base that supports dental health, and serve duck jelly and catnip pouches as a delicious, hydrating meal option. Adjust daily portions according to your cat's weight and activity level, and always ensure constant access to fresh drinking water.

sections.title: Product details
sections.text: Carnilove True Fresh Dry Duck for Junior Large Dogs Pack – an innovative set of fresh duck food for raising large breed dogs. The Carnilove True Fresh Dry Duck pack for large junior dogs is the ultimate choice for pet parents who want to provide their growing puppy with balanced development and top nutrition. The formula contains an impressive 60% fresh duck meat and is completely free of meat, chicken, grain and potato meal - because a large breed junior deserves nutrition fully aligned with their true nature! 60% fresh duck - rich in premium protein and minerals Fresh duck serves as a highly digestible, nutrient-dense protein source with an excellent amino acid profile. It is rich in vitamins A and B3, as well as essential minerals such as iron, zinc and selenium. The exclusive use of fresh meat through innovative production technology guarantees superior palatability and natural flavor, supporting the development of lean muscle mass without demanding the junior's digestive system. Controlled Growth and Joint Support - Glucosamine and Chondroitin Large breed juniors undergo rapid growth, placing significant demand on their developing musculoskeletal system. The True Fresh Junior Large recipe is enriched with chondroprotectors (glucosamine and chondroitin from crustacean shells and cartilage), which promote the development and elasticity of the articular cartilage, protecting the joints during peak growth phases. Duck lentils, marjoram and sea buckthorn – unique superfoods for health and digestion The formula incorporates innovative ingredients. Wood (wood) acts as an outstanding source of Omega-3 fatty acids and highly bioavailable minerals. Marjoram supports smooth digestive processes and intestinal comfort, while buckthorn provides abundant vitamin C and antioxidants to strengthen the developing immune system. Salmon oil – brain and vision development plus a healthy coat The inclusion of premium salmon oil provides essential Omega-3 fatty acids (DHA and EPA). They play a vital role in the healthy development of the nervous system, brain and vision in growing dogs, while nourishing the skin and giving the coat or beautiful natural shine. How to serve Carnilove True Fresh Dry Duck Junior Large Dog Pack? sections.title: Bundle details
sections.text: Carnilove True Fresh Beef Pack 12kg + 6 tins Carnilove Dog Paté Lamb & Boar Included in the price of dry food Are you looking for a complete feeding package that combines premium quality ingredients, exceptional taste and great value? The Carnilove True Fresh Beef 12 kg pack + 6 tins of Carnilove Dog Paté lamb and wild boar included in the dry food price is the perfect choice for dog owners who want to provide their pets with a meat-rich diet inspired by their natural nutritional needs. When you purchase a 12kg bag of Carnilove True Fresh Beef dry dog ​​food, you also get 6 cans of Carnilove Dog Can Paté Lamb & Boar included in the price of the dry food. It's a great way to add variety to your dog's daily meals while enjoying even more value from the pack. Carnilove True Fresh Beef – A recipe based on fresh meat Carnilove True Fresh is a complete dry food designed for adult dogs of all breeds. Its biggest advantage is the inclusion of 60% fresh beef, providing highly digestible, premium quality protein while providing the rich, natural flavor and taste that dogs love. The recipe has been developed to reflect the biological needs of dogs. It contains no grains, potatoes or chicken - no meat, no fat - making it an excellent choice for dogs with sensitive digestive systems or common food intolerances. Fresh beef provides essential amino acids to help maintain strong muscles, while naturally providing iron, zinc and B vitamins that support normal metabolism, immune function and the nervous system. Daily Digestive Support A balanced diet is essential for your dog's overall well-being. That's why Carnilove True Fresh is also carefully selected natural ingredients that help support healthy digestion. Pumpkin is a valuable source of dietary fiber that promotes healthy digestion and efficient absorption of nutrients. Dried apple pulp provides additional fiber to help maintain intestinal balance and digestive comfort. Natural Herbs for Immune Support Carnilove also incorporates the benefits of carefully selected herbs and botanicals. Sea buckthorn supports the body's natural immune defenses while contributing to healthy digestion and cardiovascular function. Rosemary is naturally rich in antioxidants that help protect cells from oxidative stress, while thyme supports healthy kidney function. Together, these ingredients provide daily nutritional support for your dog's overall health. Healthy skin and shiny coat The recipe is enriched with premium salmon oil, a natural source of Omega-3 fatty acids. These essential nutrients support cardiovascular and nervous system health, while helping to maintain healthy skin and a soft, shiny coat. Carnilove Dog Can Paté Lamb and Boar Included in the package The package also includes 6 cans of Carnilove Dog Paté Lamb and Boar, complete and balanced, providing an excellent addition to your dog's daily diet. This delicate pâté with visible pieces of organ meat is very tasty, making it an ideal choice even for fussy eaters. The recipe contains 67% meat and offal, providing high-quality protein and exceptional flavor. The combination of lamb and wild boar provides easily digestible protein and essential amino acids that help support muscle maintenance and tissue regeneration. Lamb is widely recognized as a hypoallergenic protein source, while lean wild boar meat helps maintain ideal body condition due to its naturally low fat content. Natural ingredients for everyday health The wet food is enriched with black currants, a natural source of antioxidants that help support your dog's immune system. Pea flour provides plant-based protein, fiber and valuable nutrients that contribute to healthy digestion. Lignocellulose supports healthy intestinal function, promotes digestive comfort and helps maintain an optimal body weight. Supporting proper hydration With a moisture content of 78%, wet food helps increase your dog's daily fluid intake. This is especially beneficial for dogs who naturally drink less water, supporting healthy kidney and urinary tract function. The perfect combination of dry and wet food Combining meat-rich dry food with a delicious pâté allows you to diversify your dog's daily meals while increasing his enjoyment. The wet food can be served as a complete meal or mixed with Carnilove True Fresh dry food to enhance flavor and provide extra hydration. Carnilove True Fresh Beef 12 kg + 6 cans Carnilove Dog Paté Lamb & Boar included in the dry food price is an excellent choice for dog owners who want to provide their adult dog with a complete, meat-rich diet made from natural ingredients that support everyday health and vitality. By combining premium dry and wet food in one convenient package, you can offer your dog a varied and nutritious feeding experience tailored to his natural nutritional needs.

carnilove-ACTIVE_Puppy_starter_pack.description: ACTIVE starter pack for puppies of all breeds.

sections.title: Product details
sections.text: Carnilove Puppy Starter Pack – a healthy start and the power of wild nature for your puppy. Out of respect for the instincts and needs of a growing young dog, the Carnilove brand has created the ideal starter pack for puppies. The Carnilove Puppy Starter Pack is a comprehensive kit designed to safely introduce your puppy to a world of healthy wild meat nutrition. Inside you'll find a carefully curated selection of dry food, wet food and treats designed to support healthy growth. All of this comes completely grain, potato, soy and artificial additive free - because a growing puppy deserves nutrition fully aligned with their natural needs! Salmon and turkey – perfectly balanced proteins for growth Puppy set is based on highly digestible and nutrient-rich meats such as salmon and turkey. They provide the optimal amino acid profile essential for the proper development of muscles, bones and internal organs. This deliciously savory mixture gently supports your chicken's digestive system during the most important stage of growth. Salmon oil and DHA – brain and vision development Young bodies need dedicated support for nervous system development. The included salmon oil provides essential Omega-3 fatty acids (including DHA and EPA) that promote healthy brain development, cognitive abilities and clear vision. Plus, it nourishes your pup's delicate skin and leaves their first coat soft and shiny. Berries and herbs – protecting developing immunity Supporting the immune system during growth is essential. Thanks to the addition of berries (raspberries, blueberries, cranberries) and selected herbs, these recipes provide natural vitamins and antioxidants that strengthen the body's natural defenses and support a healthy gut microbiome. How to use the Carnilove Puppy Starter Pack? This starter box includes everything needed for your puppy's first few weeks in their new home. Dry food serves as a solid, completely balanced daily basis. Wet food works great as a tasty topper or soft meal option to ease the transition from breast milk, while the included treats are essential for early house training and basic commands. Remember to adjust the portion size according to your puppy's age and weight, and always keep fresh water available.

Salmon and turkey – optimal energy for muscle and bone growth The nutritional foundation for young cats in the Kitten set is based on highly digestible, nutrient-rich meat: salmon and turkey. They provide a complete amino acid profile along with calcium and phosphorus in ideal proportions, promoting strong muscle building, healthy bone and tooth growth, and providing the energy needed for daily play and exploration. Salmon oil and DHA – brain, vision development and a healthy coat A kitten's developing nervous system requires dedicated support. The premium salmon oil included in these recipes provides essential Omega-3 fatty acids (including DHA and EPA). These vital nutrients boost brain development, cognitive skills and clear vision, while nourishing delicate skin and making your kitten's fur remarkably soft and shiny. Cranberries and berries – supporting the urinary tract and increasing immunity A cat's urinary system requires proper care from the first months of life. The addition of cranberries, blueberries and raspberries helps maintain optimal urinary pH, protecting your kitten's urinary tract. Berries also serve as a rich source of natural antioxidants and vitamins that strengthen the developing immune system. How to use the Carnilove Active Kitten Starter Pack? This starter pack is a versatile pack for your kitten's first few weeks in a new home. Dry kibbles serve as a crunchy, balanced daily foundation that helps with dental hygiene. Wet food in pouches or tins is perfect as a delicious meal option that ensures optimal hydration, while included treats serve as ideal rewards for bonding and encouraging good habits. Remember to adjust the portion size according to the kitten's age and weight, and always make sure fresh drinking water is available.

sections.title: Product details
sections.text: Carnilove Can Pack Dog - a set of flavors from the wild in a wet version for your dog Out of respect for the instincts and primal nature of each dog, the Carnilove brand has prepared a unique set of cans that allows you to bring your dog's diet directly to the wild forest. Carnilove Can Pack Dog is the perfect choice for pet parents who want to diversify their dog's menu and offer them the highest quality meat in the form of a delicious meat pâté. What's more, you won't find grains, potatoes, soy or artificial colors in these wet food recipes – because dogs deserve nutrition that is fully in line with their natural needs! A multitude of wild flavors – high meat content. The Carnilove box is a great way to discover your pet's favorite flavor. The package contains a variety of compositions based on rare meats of wild origin (such as duck, pheasant, wild boar, lamb, reindeer or salmon). Such diversity is not only a great feast for your dog's senses, but above all an excellent, highly digestible source of various proteins and amino acids that support muscle condition, provide vital energy and maintain robust health. Berries – natural antioxidants and digestive support Your pet needs more than meat; they also need natural ingredients to support their overall well-being! In Carnilove preserves, this vital role is played by berries: raspberries, blueberries and cranberries. They are a powerful natural source of antioxidants that neutralize free radicals, strengthen your dog's general immunity and, in addition, have a positive effect on the urinary tract and digestion. Salmon oil - for healthy skin and a shiny coat The aromatic recipes of Carnilove preserves could not be complete without salmon oil - one of the essential ingredients in a healthy dog's daily diet. It is a rich source of Omega-3 unsaturated fatty acids, which support the nervous and cardiovascular systems, while effectively helping to calm inflammation, improve skin quality and give your pet's coat a unique shine. How is the Carnilove Can Pack Dog set served? The wet food in the Can Pack Dog set is extremely versatile! You can serve it as a stand-alone, completely balanced meal or use it as a tasty topper for dry food to make the diet more appealing and encourage any fussy eater. Serve food at room temperature to bring out its full flavor. The recommended daily portion depends on your pet's weight, age and activity level. Once opened, keep the can in the refrigerator and always give your dog constant access to a bowl of fresh water.

carnilove-ACTIVE_Adult_Dog_starter_pack.description: ACTIVE starter pack for adult dogs of all breeds.

sections.title: Product details
sections.text: Carnilove Active Adult Dog Starter Pack – a powerful dose of energy and wild nature in one box Out of respect for the instincts and boundless energy of active dogs, the Carnilove brand has created a comprehensive starter kit that perfectly meets the needs of dogs in constant motion. Carnilove Active Adult Dog Starter Pack is an excellent choice for pet parents who want to introduce their dog to the world of wild flavors and provide them with the highest quality fuel for daily activities. Inside the box, you will find a carefully selected package of products (dry food, wet food and jam). Of course, you won't find grains, potatoes, soy or artificial preservatives in any of our recipes – because working and active dogs deserve a diet that is fully in line with their natural needs! Lots of Wild Flavors - Protein for Strong Muscles The Carnilove Starter Pack is the perfect way to test our flagship products. Based on the highest quality meat of wild origin (such as reindeer, wild boar, salmon or duck), it provides highly digestible protein, essential for rapid recovery after exercise and building strong muscles. It is a strong dose of energy that will satisfy even the most demanding palates and will ensure your dog's vitality at every walk or training session. Berries, vegetables and herbs – natural support for a body in motion An active pet that makes physical effort needs solid protection! In Carnilove products, this vital role is played by the gifts of the forest: raspberries, blueberries, cranberries and specially selected herbs and roots (e.g. chicory root). These are natural sources of powerful antioxidants that neutralize free radicals produced during intense physical exertion, protect cells and support the proper functioning of joints and the digestive system. Salmon oil and shellfish shells - for healthy joints and heart Recipes for active dogs could not be complete without ingredients that protect the musculoskeletal system. Cartilage extract and marine crustacean shells are excellent sources of glucosamine and chondroitin, which care for the condition of tense joints and tendons. In turn, the addition of salmon oil, rich in Omega-3 and Omega-6 fatty acids, fully supports the heart and nervous system and guarantees a healthy and shiny coat, despite frequent outdoor adventures. How to use Carnilove Active Adult Dog Starter Pack? The starter pack is a complete package that gives you great opportunities to diversify your diet! Treat dry food as a strong and balanced basis for your daily menu. Wet food (cans/snacks) can be served as a separate, very tasty meal to help with hydration or as a delicious kibble topper. The treats included in the set provide excellent motivation and a quick boost of energy during training or long hikes. Remember to adjust the daily dose to your dog's actual activity level and make sure they always have constant access to fresh water.

sections.title: Product details
sections.text: Carnilove Active Starter Pack for Adult Cats – a dose of energy and wild nature in one set for your adult cat Out of respect for the instincts and uncompromising carnivorous nature of adult cats, the Carnilove brand has created a comprehensive starter kit adapted to their daily needs. Carnilove Active Adult Cat Starter Pack is the perfect choice for pet parents who want to diversify their cat's diet and give them an optimal boost of energy for daily activities. Inside the box you will find a carefully curated selection of products (dry food, wet food in a box/pouch and delicious treats). All recipes are 100% grain, potato, soy free and made without artificial preservatives - because an adult predator deserves nutrition fully aligned with their biology! A multitude of wild flavors – protein for strong muscles and vitality The set for adult cats is based on highly digestible meat and fish of wild origin (such as reindeer, duck, salmon or wild boar). These ingredients provide complete protein and essential amino acids (including taurine, vital to feline health) to maintain lean muscle mass, support heart and vision health, and provide energy for active cats. Cranberries and berries – urinary tract protection The urinary system of an adult cat requires constant care. The cranberries included in Carnilove products help maintain optimal urinary pH and protect the urinary tract against infections. Added blueberries and raspberries provide natural antioxidants that neutralize free radicals and boost your cat's immunity. Salmon oil and hair disease control Carnilove recipes for adult cats could not be complete without salmon oil - a rich source of Omega-3 and Omega-6 unsaturated fatty acids. These nutrients nourish the skin, give the coat a vibrant shine and help reduce inflammation. Balanced levels of natural dietary fiber facilitate the safe passage of ingested hair through the digestive tract, helping to prevent hair bubbles. How to use Carnilove Active Adult Cat Starter Pack? This starter pack is an ideal way to add variety to your cat's daily routine. Dry kibbles serve as a crunchy foundation that supports dental health, moist food served at room temperature provides essential hydration and irresistible flavor, while included treats make perfect rewards after a successful play session. Remember to adjust daily portions based on your cat's weight and activity level, and always make sure fresh drinking water is available.

neoterica-inspector-inspector-ear-drops-.name: Inspector Ear drops for dogs and cats, 10 ml
neoterica-inspector-inspector-ear-drops-.description: Ear drops for dogs and cats, indicated in the treatment of otitis externa and otitis media of parasitic and bacterial etiology (otodectosis / auricular mange and bacterial otitis). Produced by Ekoprom, Neoterica Inspector range.
features: It treats the most common ear conditions with a single product: otodectosis (ear ringworm) and otitis of bacterial etiology.
Rapid therapeutic effect, regardless of the severity of the condition.
Moxidectin penetrates deep into the skin and quickly eliminates parasites.
Levofloxacin provides a complex antibacterial effect.

sections.title: Directions
sections.text: Inspector ear drops are used for the treatment of dogs and cats in external and average otitis of parasitic and bacterial etiology: otodectosis (ear ringworm) and bacterial otitis. Treats the most common ear conditions without the need to purchase multiple products.

sections.title: Active substances and action
sections.text: Moxidectin — penetrates deep into the skin and quickly eliminates parasites. Levofloxacin — provides a complex antibacterial effect. Salicylic acid — reduces inflammation.

sections.title: Mode of administration
sections.text: Before application, the external auditory canal is cleaned of crusts and secretions. Apply in each ear: cats and small dogs — 2-3 drops, medium-sized dogs — 4 drops, large dogs — 5 drops. The ear canal is gently massaged at the base. In the initial stages of otodectosis, it is applied only once, with repetition after 5-7 days; in case of complication with bacterial otitis or inflammation of the auricle and auditory canal — once a day for 5-7 days. The product is applied in both ears, even if only one is affected.

neoterica-inspector-inspector-quadro-tab.name: Inspector Quadro Tabs — antiparasitic tablets for cats and dogs 0.5–2 kg
neoterica-inspector-inspector-quadro-tab.description: Inspector Quadro Tabs — complex tablets against 20 external and internal parasites for cats and dogs weighing 0.5–2 kg (including kittens and puppies). Indicated in the treatment and prevention of infestations with fleas and insects, ixodid ticks, mites (demodex, otodectes, sarcoptes, notohedres), gastrointestinal nematodes (toxocarosis, toxascariosis, uncinariasis, hookworm, trichocephalosis), cestodes (taeniases, dipylidiasis, echinococcosis, diphyllobotriosis, mesocestoidosis), mixed nematode-cestone invasions, as well as for the prevention dirofilariasis. Produced by Ekoprom, Neoterica Inspector range; formula developed by Neoterica GmbH (Germany).
features: Quadro-protection: ticks, insects and their larvae, nematodes (including heartworms) and cestodes.
One product for external and internal parasites — no need for two separate preparations.
It can be used throughout the year, for prophylactic purposes.
Safe for all breeds; for kittens and puppies from 3 weeks of age.
Treatment of collie, sheltie and bobtail dogs is carried out under the supervision of a veterinarian.

sections.title: Directions
sections.text: Inspector Quadro Tabs are administered to adult cats and dogs, kittens and puppies for the treatment and prevention of entomosis, demodectosis, otodectosis, sarcoptosis, notohedrosis, acarosis produced by ixodid ticks, gastrointestinal nematodes (toxocariasis, toxascariosis, uncinariasis, hookworm, trichocephalosis), cestodes (taenia, dipylidiasis, echinococcosis, diphyllobothriasis, mesocestoidosis), nematodo-cestone associated invasions, as well as for the prevention of dirofilariasis.

sections.title: Active substances
sections.text: 1 tablet contains: lufenuron 20 mg, moxidectin 0.6 mg, praziquantel 10 mg.

sections.title: Mode of administration

neoterica-insektal-insektal-insektal-pic.name: Insektal — spot-on drops for cats and dogs 2–4 kg
neoterica-insektal-insektal-insektal-pic.description: Insektal drops are used against ectoparasites of dogs and cats. It is administered from the age of 3 months in entomosis, otodectosis, notohedrosis, sarcoptosis and ixodid tick infestations. It is applied spot-on: the fur is loosened and the product is applied to the dry and intact skin of the neck area, at the base of the skull or between the shoulder blades, in places inaccessible to licking. Protection after a single application: against ticks — up to 30 days in dogs and 21 days in cats; against insects — up to 2 months in dogs and 1.5 months in cats. Produced by Ekoprom, Neoterica Insektal range.
features: Two-component formula: fipronil + pyriproxyfen — acts on ectoparasites in all stages of development.
Simple spot-on application on dry skin, in the neck area or between the shoulder blades.
Long protection after a single application.

neoterica-rolfclub-3d-rolfclub-rolfclub-.name: RolfClub 3D — antiparasitic drops for cats under 4 kg
neoterica-rolfclub-3d-rolfclub-rolfclub-.description: RolfClub 3D drops for cats are administered to cats and kittens over 12 weeks old in entomosis (fleas, malophages), otodectosis, notohedrosis, ixodid tick infestation and for protection against hematophagous flying insects. It is applied once using the spot-on method on dry and integrated skin, in the area of ​​the neck at the base of the skull or between the shoulder blades. Ticks and parasitic insects detach and die within 1–2 hours. The protective action lasts 30 days against ixodid ticks and up to 2 months against insects. Produced by Ekoprom, Neoterica RolfClub 3D range.
features: Triple protection: destroys parasites before the bite, protects the animal for up to 2 months and interrupts the reproduction of parasites.
Knock-down effect in 2 minutes: Paralytic action prevents the tick from moving and biting.
Protection against 9 types of external parasites: ixodid, otodectic and sarcoptic ticks, fleas (all stages), lice, malophages, mosquitoes and midges.
The active substances are not absorbed into the systemic circulation — safe for the animal.
The three-component formula does not induce resistance to parasites.
